$comment: phosphene vttui catalog v0.1: the A2UI v0.9.1 basic catalog plus terminal-derived extensions. Renderers that only know the basic catalog can ignore unknown props.

Progress.description: Determinate progress (bars, gauges, meters). value is 0..1 or null when indeterminate (spinner).

style.description: Faithful-render hints from the source terminal.

area.description: [row0, col0, row1, col1) in terminal cells

highlight.description: Text: true when the terminal shows this item selected

shortcut.description: Button: the terminal key that triggers it (e.g. ^X, F1, q)

role.description: List: the VTM role of the region (log, table, code, ...)

theme.palette: map of ansi-0..ansi-15, default-fg, default-bg -> CSS colour
